title: Review verdict
description: Written by the reviewer to $TASK_DIR/reports/review-reviewer.json. The verdict selects the pipeline's next transition, so the enum is exact.

verdict.description: APPROVE: all criteria met, nothing blocking. REQUEST_CHANGES: blocking findings fixable within the current plan. REPLAN: the plan itself is wrong. ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN: reviewer/planner disagreement on intent, ill-posed task, or a product decision.

ac_table.description: One row per acceptance criterion in task.md. Every AC must appear, including ones that are fine.

status.description: met_untested is a real answer — use it rather than rounding to met or unmet.

evidence.description: Test name, file:line, or verify output supporting the status.

finding.description: Finding id, when the status is not met.

findings.description: Blocking and non-blocking defects. Every BLOCKING finding must carry a citation.

claim.description: What is wrong, where, and what 'fixed' looks like — written so the implementer need not re-derive your reasoning.

cite.description: task.md#AC-n, plan.md:Lnn, decisions.md#D-n, or verify output. Required: an uncited finding belongs in advisory and cannot block.

suggested_owner.description: Subtask id that should own the fix, e.g. impl:st-2.

advisory.description: Observations, taste, and future work. Recorded, never gating.

unlogged_scope_violations.description: Diff hunks matching neither a subtask file_scope nor a logged deviation. Mechanically checkable; report all of them.

regression_surface.description: Existing behavior sharing the touched code paths, and whether the verify run exercised it.

previous_findings_addressed.description: Second and later review rounds only.
